offering_description.value: Provides hormone optimization therapy, using bioidentical hormone pellets, to patients who are treated by licensed clinicians in its network. It sells the therapy, product and training packages through certified partner clinics, which deliver treatment and bill patients.

primary_services.value: clinician training and certification; practice support; patient program management

customer_segment.value: B2B: licensed physicians and clinics that join its certified provider network; B2C: patients receiving hormone optimization treatment through partner clinics

end_markets.value: healthcare; hormone therapy; wellness and anti-aging

revenue_model.value: product sales: hormone pellets and supplements sold to partner clinics; service fees: clinician training, certification and practice support fees

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: owns the Biote Method brand and sells its therapy products to clinics; service provider: trains and supports clinicians who treat patients, selling to provider clinics

geography_served.value: US national: partner clinics across the United States

specialization.value: niche specialist: hormone optimization therapy and its related products and training

distribution_channels.value: partners / resellers: independent licensed clinics that deliver treatment to patients; direct sales: company sales staff who recruit and support provider clinics

regulatory_exposure.value: high: hormone drug products and clinical treatment regulated by FDA and state medical boards
